title: Coping Dynamics Sequencing: reproducible analysis pipeline for keypoint-MoSeq behavioral motif dynamics of stress coping
description:
Self-contained analysis repository accompanying the manuscript on behavioral motif, freezing, and stress-coping dynamics in mice. It bundles every input needed to rebuild the data-derived figures, statistical model outputs, Excel reports, and validation manifest, together with the keypoint-MoSeq syllable analyses, litter-clustered statistical models, and the behavior classifier used for the resilience prediction.

Every artifact regenerates byte-identically from source with a single command; integrity is enforced by a SHA-256 manifest and verified in continuous integration on Windows and Linux. A companion DeepLabCut-based behavior classifier ships with its trained tracking networks, demo footage, and its own test suite.
notes: Artifact reproducibility is a same-machine guarantee: figures are built with SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=0 and artifact line endings are normalized before hashing. Rebuilds on a different platform can differ in last digits on BLAS-sensitive model fits.
